create_discussion_dataclass: create a Discussion dataclass instance representing a Hub discussion or pull request with title, status, repo_id, and author
build_discussion_with_details: build a DiscussionWithDetails dataclass instance including events, conflicting_files, target_branch, merge_commit_oid, and diff
deserialize_event_from_dict: deserialize a raw event dict into a typed DiscussionEvent subclass like DiscussionComment, DiscussionStatusChange, DiscussionCommit, or DiscussionTitleChange
get_discussion_url: get the Hub URL for a Discussion or Pull Request based on its repo_type, repo_id, and discussion number
get_pr_git_reference: get the git reference string for pushing changes to a Pull Request discussion on the Hub
